name: design-system-forge
description: Turns a single image, screenshot, mood board, or one small sentence into a complete, production-grade design system — tokens, components, all states, light/dark, plus an art-directed documentation shell. Five verbs: build, audit, study, redesign, audit-kit. Includes a creativity dial (safe to experimental) plus an independent visitor-mode axis (Persuade/Operate/Read/Experience), a sourced anti-generic standard (checked against Anthropic's and Google Material Design 3's live artifacts, with an honest note on where a third source had nothing citable), a thirteen-item AI-Slop Ledger and a motion-system rule set both with stable IDs, an auto-audit hook that runs on every edit in a managed project, and an optional comp-first workflow when image generation is available.
